capabilities: Search community plugins by Chinese keyword, original name or author
Translate plugin names, descriptions and READMEs into Chinese
Rank plugins by on-device semantic vectors or AI semantic search
Filter plugins by source, category, author and install state
Compare similar plugins side by side with AI analysis
disambiguation: Not a separate plugin store; it searches the same community plugin market and adds Chinese search, filters and translation on top.
extras: The manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff, and the README says the default Tencent translation channel is an unofficial reverse-engineered interface (transmart.qq.com) that may break at any time, falling back to later channels.
intentEvidence: It tears down the language barrier of the default (English-only) community plugin browser
motivation: The author was frustrated that finding a 'mind map' plugin in the English-only market could take half an hour of guessing, and wanted to remove that language barrier.
problem: Obsidian's community plugin browser lists 5,000+ plugins with English names only, making it slow and hard for Chinese-speaking users to find and evaluate plugins.
